items.name: Kinda Maybe Mini-sota 2025
items.information:
### There is no 3x3 at this competition and it is held on a *Tuesday evening*

##### This competition is **not recommended** for new competitiors. It will only host 4x4 and Square-1.

**[Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=minnesota&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)**

|  |
| -------- |

Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the competing room to ensure we have enough space. Additional guests may relax in the library.
